title: TalActionEnum
description:
Sets action for TAL process
Cancel action cancels process for all phases.
Stop phase 1 stops afte phase 1 is finished and do not proceeds to phase 2.
There is no need to stop phase 2 it can be only canceled.
| Enum Value | Enum Label     |
| ---------- | ----------     |
|     0      | Dont do TAL              |
|     1      | Start phase 1 - folded   |
|     2      | Start phase 2 - elevated |
|     3      | Done                     |
|     4      | Abort                    |
